<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9ff8154cf694c616de5d467b35af21e037de1509` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

- **The step is wired the way this file requires — right.** GATE INVOCATION IDIOM (lint.yml lines 126–158): a new gate gets a root `check:*` alias of exactly `--self-test` then the gate and CI runs `pnpm check:thing`. `package.json:42` is `node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs --self-test && node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs --check`; the step runs `pnpm check:sdui-reference`. EVERY GATE RUNS (lines 168–190): unique `id:` plus `continue-on-error: true`, and the lane's last step `Lane verdict` reads the roster out of the workflow and each gate's `outcome` from `toJSON(steps)`. Measured on the head, GitHub job 122740964452 (`Lint · repo & tooling gates`, conclusion success): step 19 `SDUI manifest is present, intact and fresh at the objectui pin` success, step 20 `Component reference matches the SDUI manifest` success, step 65 `Lane verdict` success; aggregate `Lint & Repo Gates` success. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derives the family from either spelling and takes its watch hints from the module-body literals `sdui.manifest.json` and `content/docs/ui/components`; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` is green on the head.

- **`.gitattributes` `content/docs/ui/components/** merge=os-regen` — right.** It is one row with its two required companions: the `REGEN_ARTIFACTS` row (`gen:sdui-reference` / `check:sdui-reference`, `owner: ROOT_OWNER`, both aliases present in the root manifest) and the `OS_REGEN_CLASSES` row `whole`. `whole` is the true class: `writeReference` removes every entry of the directory that is not in the rendering before writing. ### ② Semver level

- `out_of_scope_findings[1]` (`object-kanban` `cardFields` description uses the ADR-0090 D3 reserved word `role`) — `carrier: none`, placed in the PR's Acceptance notes as the protocol allows. Escalated here, should-fix: the word is in the generated page (`content/docs/ui/components/plugins.mdx:272`, "`highlightFields` role"), and this PR's `SKIP_SUBTREES` entry is what stops `check:role-word` seeing it; `ui/` is outside that gate's `ROOTS` (`content/docs`, `skills`), so after this PR no gate holds the finding. The skip itself is correct (the gate's header rule for generated trees; the fix site is forbidden to this card), but the finding needs a carrier — a card for the kanban registration's description under `ui/`.

### ④ Design judgment

**`.github/workflows/lint.yml`** — the rule (one `check:*` alias runs self-test then `--check`) and the gate (one lane step, verdict kept by `Lane verdict`), read as one against `scripts/ci/lane-verdict.mjs`, the GATE INVOCATION IDIOM, `scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs` and the scenario it is accepted against (a manifest change without a regenerated reference goes red in the same PR).

Holds. Tried to break it:
- No `id:` or no `continue-on-error` — both present and the id is unique in the file, so the verdict reads the outcome rather than redding the lane "unread".
- Hand-edit one generated line — `diffReference` reports the file and first differing line (self-test row "check: one hand-edited line is drift", and the ablation the dev recorded; CI's row "the real manifest renders every component on exactly one page" runs against the live manifest on every run).
- Delete a page, add a hand page, leave a page behind after its namespace leaves the manifest — missing and stray files are both drift; a write removes strays.
- Change the generator's template without regenerating — the committed pages differ; red.
- Manifest gains a component key, input key, tier value or namespace the generator does not render — refused with the remedy, exit 1; nothing is silently omitted. Enum, union, `of` and `binding` all reach the type cell.
- Hand-edit the manifest — `check-sdui-manifest` check 2 (sha256) reds the step above; registry drift — ci.yml's regeneration step reds `Build & E2E UI`.
- Description text that breaks MDX — `cellText` escapes `{ } < |` outside code spans and `|` inside, keeps an unclosed backtick literal, and `Build Docs` compiles the pages on every PR whose diff touches `content/docs`, which a regeneration necessarily does.
- Lane budget — the gate reads two tracked inputs and builds nothing; seconds against a 10-minute body budget.
- No path filter, no `if:`, so the gate cannot go dormant on a queue build or a PR that moves only one side of its inputs.

Findings: no must-fix. Should-fix (non-blocking): (1) the PR body names the wrong lane for the step; (2) file a carrier for the `role` word in the `object-kanban` `cardFields` registration, which this PR's role-word skip removes from the gate's view.

**`.gitattributes`** (read with `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` and `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`): the routing is complete in all three registers, the class is true to the generator, and nothing about how CI treats the tree changes — CI never runs the driver; the lint step is the CI-side guard. Holds.
